vote.question: FUTARCHY CONDITIONAL RESOLUTION [US-GA U.S. Senate]: T. Jonathan Ossoff (D) has accumulated $324,881,337 in career FEC-reported receipts (anchored this cycle by SMP ($38,500,000) and $103,711,877 from top-5 patrons)—out-raising general opponent Michael A Collins Jr ($10,687,028) by 30.4x—exhibiting the "Outside Super PAC & Megadonor Swarm" profile. Will independent constituent & oracle review confirm that this private-interest capital concentration compromises public representation in US-GA, thereby executing the GA Corrective Restitution Pool toward non-partisan civic accountability, investigative public-interest journalism, and voter legal defense?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Private campaign financing treats US-GA representation as an investable asset class. When T. Jonathan Ossoff's campaign apparatus absorbs $324,881,337 (anchored this cycle by SMP ($38,500,000) and $103,711,877 from top-5 patrons), policy incentives skew toward dilution of local constituent voice via concentrated ideological/outside Super PAC bundlers. This futarchy market converts spectator outrage into direct fiscal counter-leverage.
options: Yes — Confirm Capture & Execute State Restitution Bounty
No — Veto Capture Claim & Roll Escrow Pool to Bipartisan Commons
Abstain — Log On-Chain Constituent Dissent Only
